name: Universal Scripts
desc: Universal Roblox scripts, admin command panels, and game-agnostic utilities engineered to work across any Roblox experience.

scripts.title: Nullware Hub V3
scripts.features:
Nullware Hub V3 Improvements/Features:

+ It features the most optimized and fastest reanimate of all time, see it for yourself. ;)
+ Seamless Reanimation; the moment you click the Reanimate button, you will be reanimated seamlessly and almost instantly.
+ Fixed the crash issue completely.
+ It uses the least memory compared to our competitors.
+ It has seamless R15 To R6 support; which allows you to transform your character from R15 into R6 seamlessly. This also allows you to use R6 Animation's and R6 Script's.
+ It also has the following unique features (but is not limited to):
    * Head Movement Without Godmode; this one is pretty much self-explanatory.
    * Full compatibility with admin scripts such as Infinite Yield; if you run a command such as ``fly`` from Infinite Yield whilst reanimated, it will work with no problems.
    * Auto converter for scripts; if you run a non-FE script whilst reanimated, the reanimate will convert it to FE automatically so people can see your animations without requiring any extra work.
    * Support for FD constraints such as Weld's; if you create Weld's in your character whilst reanimated (to weld your hats or body parts for example), the reanimate will convert the Weld's to FE meaning other people will also see that you welded your hats or body parts.
    * An Easy-to-use API for Developers called NullwareAPI. (We will post a new Documentation for NullwareAPI soon, stay tuned!)
    * If someone kills you while you are reanimated, and if it has been 7 seconds since you reanimated, you will become godmodded automatically and will not die.
    * Hat Preview support; If you don't have the required hats for a Hat Script in the hub, the hub will give you the hat's client-sided (which means only you can see it) so you can test the hat script without having to buy the hat's. And no, this will not affect the fling.

Join nullware discord server for list of required hats: https://discord.gg/ukBFMxVCKS

If you want to support the developer use this link to get the script: https://linkvertise.com/166414/nullware-hub-v3-full/
